skills.name: solak-create-skill
skills.description: Scaffolds a new skill in the solak-skills repository: creates the folder, fills the SKILL.md template, validates naming and updates the registry.

skills.name: solak-design-ui
skills.description: Designs and implements UX-first, data-dense enterprise interfaces. Starts from the user's primary task, information hierarchy, task flow and a layout skeleton; then reduces friction, inventories every state the surface can reach, chooses density and typography, produces an ordered implementation TODO and executes it step by step, validating each item before the next. Visual polish comes last. Covers tables, filter panels, data-entry forms, report screens and metric dashboards with all the states real data produces — loading, empty, no-results, partial, stale, error, conflict, offline — and the feedback, retry, undo and confirmation behaviour around them. Self-contained: carries its own UX workflow, layout, responsive, interaction-state, design-quality, token, typography, formatting and chart rules with no dependency on other skills or external rule files.
